name: Ferocious Bite
description: Finishing move that causes damage per combo point and converts each extra point of energy into 2 additional damage.  Damage is increased by your attack power.   1 point  : 122-162 damage   2 points: 214-254 damage   3 points: 306-346 damage   4 points: 398-438 damage   5 points: 490-530 damage
